reviews.text: Can't say enough about service received.  Marcos was friendly, polite, respectful of my home and can-do. I felt very confident in him from onset.  I had 5 different ceiling lights installed, two with a fan. He got them done efficiently and even took time to share some tips on using the remote.  I would certainly recommend both ACE and Marcos and intend to request him for future handyman services.
reviews.author: dina campbell

reviews.text: Marcos was amazing! He listened to our requests and explained everything very thoroughly. He did fantastic work and cleaned up the work areas upon completion. We will definitely have him back as we continue he to ck things off our punch list.
reviews.author: Melissa Phillips

reviews.text: Marcos, and Ace Handyman, have made our closet addition very easy. The communication has been clear, about each step of our project, and tasks have been completed as scheduled. Marcos was also very conscientious about protecting floors and cleaning up.
reviews.author: Deborah Piper

reviews.text: Marcos was out to trim a couple of solid wood interior doors for us. Marcos was very professional and knew what he was doing. He took my suggestions into mind and took extra precautions when needed to assure that everything went well. The doors look great.
reviews.author: Greg McCormick

reviews.text: Marcos was awesome! He came early and worked very fast to get my necklace out of the drain for me. He was so kind and professional . Thank you Marcos for all of the help!
reviews.author: Madelon Parrillo
